0022600101.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West) are on the road against the Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West) in Memphis' second game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Grizzlies lost 0-3, most recently 133-112 in Memphis on February 25, 2026. Memphis is missing Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Golden State is without Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
